title.narrative: Central Asia Energy Water Development Program (CAEWDP) Multi Donor Trust Fund

description.narrative:
"To strengthen the enabling environment to promote energy and water security at regional level and in the beneficiary countries.
The Central Asia Energy and Water Development Program aims at strengthening the enabling environment through the generation of knowledge (data and diagnostic analyses), strengthening of institutions (capacity building), dialogue processes and investments that promote energy and water security and help realize the benefits of regional cooperation to advance sustainable development and climate resilience, goals inherent to energy and water security."
